name: @tyvm/knowhow-benchmarks
description: Benchmarking framework and leaderboard for Knowhow terminal agent

scripts.build: npm run build:benchmarks && npm run build:leaderboard
scripts.computer:precision: ts-node exercises/computer-use/runner.ts --exercise click-grid --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai --rounds 10 --seed 41001
scripts.computer:precision:voice-parity: ts-node exercises/computer-use/runner.ts --exercise click-grid --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai --rounds 10 --natural-discovery
scripts.computer:ui-basics: ts-node exercises/computer-use/runner.ts --exercise ui-basics --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai
scripts.computer:media: npm run computer:run -- --exercise media-controls --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai
scripts.computer:email: npm run computer:run -- --exercise email-inbox --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai
scripts.computer:tasks: npm run computer:run -- --exercise task-management --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai
scripts.computer:checkout: npm run computer:run -- --exercise checkout --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai
scripts.computer:tabs: npm run computer:run -- --exercise browser-tabs --agent ComputerUseAgent --model gpt-5.6-luna --provider openai

author: Micah Riggan
